title: 真实Git LFS锁接管：保留离线修改，核对owner及锁ID，批准强解也不能误删新一代锁
body:
## 操作任务
实现release_lock(run,path,approved_id,approved_owner,caller,force_authorized,local_bytes,approved_local_sha256)。run是题给的私有身份上下文，实际执行Git LFS argv并解析成功JSON，失败抛RuntimeError。先核对实际离线内容字节及题外批准SHA256，不能自动丢弃或覆盖离线修改；参数非空且force_authorized必须bool。实际git lfs locks --json --path=指定路径，必须精确一条且path/id/owner.name与批准快照一致，否则ValueError。caller为owner可正常解锁；他人锁只有caller=admin且有明确force授权才允许，否则PermissionError且不发解锁请求。实际unlock使用批准的--id，不使用路径重新找锁；只有批准他人接管才加--force。任何远端错误传播，不能改用新ID或盲目重试。返回释放的批准ID。验证锁与离线文件状态是两回事，强解不代表旧客户端被技术上隔离；接管前还需实际协作确认、保存修改和业务流程约束。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Windows Git2.54/Git LFS3.7.1客户端，连接受控私有回环Locking API服务；HTTP创建冲突、owner拒绝、批准admin force和原生客户端交错unlock/relock均真实执行。三个隔离临时仓库使用子进程独立配置，不改宿主默认Git身份、认证或配置。实际二进制文件含未提交离线修改，接管后字节和脏状态保持。只验证锁管理子流程，夹具文件由Git跟踪，不假装执行了远程LFS大对象传输、托管产品IAM、TLS基础设施、push/pre-push强制策略或旧写者fencing；相关生产环节需单独验证。锁服务是最小协议夹具，不声称为商业托管平台。所有操作仅自有临时资源，不构建镜像。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from lfs_fixture import Fixture
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
import task
def digest(value):return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
def error_of(call):
 try:call()
 except Exception as exc:return type(exc)
 return None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-lfs-takeover-") as root,Fixture() as fixture:
 alice=fixture.init_repo(root,"alice");bob=fixture.init_repo(root,"bob");admin=fixture.init_repo(root,"admin");race=fixture.init_repo(root,"race")
 assert "git-lfs/" in fixture.command(alice,"alice",["lfs","version"]).stdout
 def run(repo,user):
  return lambda args:json.loads(fixture.command(repo,user,args).stdout)
 a=run(alice,"alice");b=run(bob,"bob");op=run(admin,"admin");ar=run(race,"alice")
 lock=a(["lfs","lock","--json","asset.bin"])[0];identifier=lock["id"]
 offline=(alice/"asset.bin").read_bytes()+b"uncommitted offline edits\x00keep\n";(alice/"asset.bin").write_bytes(offline);approved=digest(offline)
 assert fixture.command(alice,"alice",["status","--porcelain"]).stdout.strip(),"offline edit was not real"
 def release(fn,expected_id,owner,caller,force,raw=offline,sha=approved):
  return task.release_lock(fn,"asset.bin",expected_id,owner,caller,force,raw,sha)
 print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: native Git LFS lock identity, offline edits and approved takeover",flush=True)
 before=len(fixture.requests)
 assert error_of(lambda:release(b,identifier,"alice","bob",False)) is PermissionError
 assert identifier in fixture.locks and not any(row["method"]=="POST" for row in fixture.requests[before:])
 assert error_of(lambda:release(op,identifier,"alice","admin",False)) is PermissionError
 before=len(fixture.requests)
 assert error_of(lambda:release(op,identifier,"alice","admin",True,sha="0"*64)) is ValueError
 assert len(fixture.requests)==before,"unapproved bytes caused server activity"
 assert release(op,identifier,"alice","admin",True)==identifier and not fixture.locks
 assert (alice/"asset.bin").read_bytes()==offline and fixture.command(alice,"alice",["status","--porcelain"]).stdout.strip()
 assert fixture.requests[-1]["status"]==200 and fixture.requests[-1]["user"]=="admin" and fixture.requests[-1]["force"] is True
 acquired=b(["lfs","lock","--json","asset.bin"])[0];assert acquired["owner"]["name"]=="bob" and acquired["id"]!=identifier
 assert error_of(lambda:release(op,identifier,"alice","admin",True)) is ValueError and acquired["id"] in fixture.locks
 bob_bytes=(bob/"asset.bin").read_bytes()
 assert release(b,acquired["id"],"bob","bob",False,raw=bob_bytes,sha=digest(bob_bytes))==acquired["id"]
 assert not fixture.locks and fixture.requests[-1]["force"] is False
 old=ar(["lfs","lock","--json","asset.bin"])[0];replacement=[]
 def replace_before_snapshot_response():
  ar(["lfs","unlock","--id="+old["id"],"--json"])
  replacement.append(ar(["lfs","lock","--json","asset.bin"])[0])
 fixture.before_list_response=replace_before_snapshot_response
 caught=error_of(lambda:release(op,old["id"],"alice","admin",True))
 assert caught is RuntimeError,"stale preflight was treated as successful release"
 assert len(replacement)==1 and replacement[0]["id"]!=old["id"] and replacement[0]["id"] in fixture.locks,"new lock generation was force released by path"
 assert (alice/"asset.bin").read_bytes()==offline
 print("NATIVE_GIT_LFS_REAL_CLIENT_OWNER_DENIAL_ADMIN_FORCE_OFFLINE_BYTES_RETAINED_NEW_OWNER_ACQUIRES",flush=True)
 print("NATIVE_GIT_LFS_STALE_LIST_INTERLEAVED_REAL_OWNER_UNLOCK_RELOCK_OLD_ID_REFUSED_NEW_LOCK_PRESERVED",flush=True)
 print("NATIVE_LFS_LOCK_OBSERVATIONS "+json.dumps(dict(requests=fixture.requests,old_id=old["id"],replacement_id=replacement[0]["id"],offline_sha256=approved,offline_edits_still_uncommitted=True)),flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
